subject: Apply an anime cel-shading LUT. See .rundeer/luts/anime_cel.md for the full LUT specification. Quantize colors into flat cel-like bands with hard transitions between shadows, midtones, and highlights. Saturate primary and secondary colors strongly. Add a faint line-art enhancement to edges. Remove photographic gradients in favor of flat fills. Colors should look hand-painted and ink-keyed as if scanned from animation cels. Keep the color palette bold and deliberately limited. Preserve all composition and subject identity.
